passage.text: Bangkok is a safe city, but visitors should be aware of a few problems.
passage.reading: ˈbæŋkɑːk ɪz ə ˈseɪf ˈsɪti, bʌt ˈvɪzɪtərz ʃʊd bi əˈwɛr əv ə ˈfjuː ˈprɑːbləmz.

passage.text: Keep an eye on your bag in crowded places, such as markets and trains.
passage.reading: ˈkiːp ən ˈaɪ ɑːn jʊr ˈbæɡ ɪn ˈkraʊdɪd ˈpleɪsɪz, ˈsʌtʃ əz ˈmɑːrkɪts ənd ˈtreɪnz.

passage.text: Leave your passport at your hotel, and keep a photo of it on your phone.
passage.reading: ˈliːv jʊr ˈpæspɔːrt ət jʊr hoʊˈtɛl, ənd ˈkiːp ə ˈfoʊtoʊ əv ɪt ɑːn jʊr ˈfoʊn.

passage.text: When you take a taxi, ask the driver to use the meter.
passage.reading: wɛn juː ˈteɪk ə ˈtæksi, ˈæsk ðə ˈdraɪvər tə ˈjuːz ðə ˈmiːtər.

passage.text: Be aware of strangers who offer you cheap tours or tell you that a temple is closed today.
passage.reading: bi əˈwɛr əv ˈstreɪndʒərz huː ˈɔːfər juː ˈtʃiːp ˈtʊrz ɔːr ˈtɛl juː ðæt ə ˈtɛmpəl ɪz ˈkloʊzd təˈdeɪ.

passage.text: If you have a problem, call the Tourist Police hotline: 1155.
passage.reading: ɪf juː ˈhæv ə ˈprɑːbləm, ˈkɔːl ðə ˈtʊrɪst pəˌliːs ˈhɑːtlaɪn: ˈwʌn ˈwʌn ˈfaɪv ˈfaɪv.

passage.text: The officers speak English, and the call is free.
passage.reading: ði ˈɔːfɪsərz ˈspiːk ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ, ənd ðə ˈkɔːl ɪz ˈfriː.

passage.text: You can also find tourist police officers at airports and big tourist attractions.
passage.reading: juː kən ˈɔːlsoʊ ˈfaɪnd ˈtʊrɪst pəˌliːs ˈɔːfɪsərz ət ˈɛrpɔːrts ənd ˈbɪɡ ˈtʊrɪst əˌtrækʃənz.

passage.text: In an emergency, call 191 for the police or 1669 for an ambulance.
passage.reading: ɪn ən ɪˈmɜːrdʒənsi, ˈkɔːl ˈwʌn ˈnaɪn ˈwʌn fər ðə pəˈliːs ɔːr ˈwʌn ˈsɪks ˈsɪks ˈnaɪn fər ən ˈæmbjələns.

passage.text: Save these emergency numbers on your phone in case you need them.
passage.reading: ˈseɪv ˈðiːz ɪˈmɜːrdʒənsi ˌnʌmbərz ɑːn jʊr ˈfoʊn ɪn ˈkeɪs juː ˈniːd ðɛm.

passage.text: Have a safe and happy trip!
passage.reading: ˈhæv ə ˈseɪf ənd ˈhæpi ˈtrɪp!
